key_insight: MentalHospital is a virtual psychiatry benchmark that tests LLMs across the full SOAP encounter, not just isolated dialogue or diagnosis tasks.
clinical_relevance: It gives researchers a more realistic way to measure how well AI supports psychiatric interviewing, assessment, and treatment planning before clinical use.
method: Built skill-augmented standardized patients from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric EHR cases across major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders.
Simulated complete Subjective Interviewing, Objective Examination, Diagnostic Assessment, and Treatment Planning encounters.
Used dual-track scoring: objective comparison to EHR references plus subjective evaluation of clinical process quality via MentalEval.
evidence_signal: The benchmark was supported by 22 clinicians, MentalEval reached strong expert alignment (average QWK 0.944), and the strongest LLM still trailed clinicians by 37.28 percentage points in objective psychiatric competence.
watch_item: Because the system relies on virtual patients, expert rubrics, and EHR-derived references, performance on the benchmark may not fully capture real-world psychiatric complexity or safety.
paper_title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
